She had dog food on her mouth, fur area that was already there previous to dropping her off. That’s the whole reason why I took her in was to get cleaned up but It honestly looked as if they just cut her hair And oversprayed her with a scent to mask the cigarette smell. TERRIBLE EXPERIENCE!
This was my third time bringing my dogs here. The first time it was okay, second time not great when my dog’s hair was cut incorrectly. However, I decided to give this place another chance. Before bringing them in today, I actually looked at some of the reviews and had a feeling that maybe I shouldn’t bring them back. Looking back now, I should have trusted my instincts because this was by far the worst experience I’ve ever had at any groomer.

I waited at the front desk for about 20 minutes before anyone helped me.
Around 6:00 PM, I called to check on my dogs and was told that one was finished and that they were working on the second one.  I specifically asked if he would be ready in 30–45 minutes and was told yes.

I returned around 7:00 PM only to be told that they had just put the second one on the grooming table. When I reminded them about my earlier phone call, I was told that the groomer’s had to leave for an emergency and other pets had to be attended to, and mine had been taken off the table. Again, I was told it would be another 30–45 minutes.

I decided to take my other dog home while waiting for the second one. When she was brought out, I immediately noticed an injury. I asked what happened, and Richard told me that she had been  cut with the scissors during grooming.  Had I not noticed it myself, I don’t believe anyone would have said anything.
I will never bring my dogs back here, and I would not recommend this place to anyone.

They even surprised me by giving Lucy the cutest mohawk down her back and added a little color to it — it was absolutely adorable!

I wish I would have listened to my gut when I first got here and just left. When I first walked in with my dog the owner's big dog behind the counter charged the gate separating it from my dog and was snarling aggressively at her. We literally just walked in, and my dog is so gentle, there were no signs of aggression from her so I don't know why the other dog was so aggressive out of nowhere. The place also looks dirty and stinks of cigarettes. I still left her to get a bath and nail trim because I have a newborn and have been needing to get her groomed but have not been able to because things are so busy right now.

I left my dog here at 12pm and didn't get her back until 6:45pm. They said it was a first come first serve basis, so I expected it to take a few hours, but not all day. When they brought her to me her eye was agitated and wouldn't open. I asked why and they said she must have gotten soap or fur in it and to just use human eye drops for her. I don't know if I believe that.

When I got her to my car I noticed that one of her dewclaws had been cut to the quick, and there was dried blood on her paw. I went back in and asked why it was cut so short. They said that her dewclaw was too long and that the quick had grown out so much it needed to be clipped back. She was overdue for a nail trim, but her dewclaws have gotten that long before and the old groomer NEVER cut her to the quick. They reassured me that it only felt like a pinch, but I know that's bs. That's very painful for a dog and is the reason we don't clip her nails ourselves but take her in to professionals. I never would have consented to that if they told me they were going to do it. Some of her other nails don't look like they were even trimmed. After nail trims she walks quietly in out tile floors, and she sounds just as clicky from her naps as she did this morning, so I know they weren't all trimmed.

Finally, when I got home, she drank water for five minutes straight and was SO thirsty. She was almost there for 7 hours, and I know no one offered her water or else she wouldn't have drank like that. I'm so mad at the treatment she received, and I would never take her back here. I feel so guilty for leaving her with them and wish I wouldn't have.

I visited Trendy Pets about a month ago and was very happy with my dog’s haircut. I also liked that they are a walk-in facility and that their pricing is in line with other groomers in the area. Based on the grooming results and value, I would gladly give them 5 stars.

Where I feel there’s room for improvement is in the cleanliness of the facility. On my first visit, there was a strong odor as soon as I walked in, and I noticed stains on the floor as well as some pet hair. I thought it might have just been an off day, so I decided to stop by again before writing a review.

When I returned yesterday, I had a similar experience — the odor was still very noticeable, the same stains seemed to be present, and there was pet hair throughout the space. No one was at the front desk when I arrived, and after waiting a few minutes, I left because the smell was difficult to handle.

I completely understand that accidents and shedding come with the territory at any groomer, but I do think a little extra attention to cleaning would make a big difference. The staff clearly does great work with grooming, and I think the overall experience could be much better if the environment matched the quality of the haircuts.

I can't say enough about our first experience with Trendy Pets Grooming Salon! I have a toy, long-haired Chihuahua (Nugget) who is almost 2 years old, but he acts like a grumpy old man. Previously, he had been groomed by a friend of the family, but when she began experiencing health issues & was no longer able to take care of him, I was really worried about taking him somewhere. He can be spicy with strangers. I know some places won't deal with dogs with "attitudes" & I don't want to traumatize him since that would just make things worse when taking him to a groomer. So needless to say - he was QUITE fluffy by the time I found this salon.
Trendy Pets Grooming was absolutely amazing! Nugget let me hand him off without any growling or grumbling - which was incredible! I was also worried because he was so fluffy at this point that they would take one look at him & say no, but they didn't even hesitate. We were a walk-in & they let me sign him up without any issues! I received an email & text "confirming" the appointment & a few hours later received a text that Nugget was ready to be picked up. When I arrived & they walked him out, it was amazing! They had given him the "summer cut" that he desperately needed & he looked incredible! They were able to get his head, ears, mane, behind & nub (he was born without a tail) trimmed perfectly! That's a feat with him because like I mentioned - he can be spicy! He didn't act traumatized or stressed at all when I picked him up & that meant a great deal to me.
The pricing is all inclusive with teeth brushing, nail trimming, anal expression, etc. & considering how much work they had to do for him, it was so much more affordable than many other places I've inquired at. Everyone was super friendly & took great care of my little fur-baby! We will definitely be back! Thank you so much Trendy Pets!!!!!
